SELECT COALESCE(SUM(taxAmount), 0) FROM tax_record WHERE isDelete = 0 AND YEAR(calcTime) = YEAR(CURDATE())

SELECT tr.userId as userId, u.realName as userName, COUNT(*) as recordCount, COALESCE(SUM(tr.taxAmount), 0) as totalTax FROM tax_record tr LEFT JOIN user u ON tr.userId = u.id WHERE tr.isDelete = 0 GROUP BY tr.userId, u.realName ORDER BY totalTax DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT YEAR(calcTime) as year, MONTH(calcTime) as month, COUNT(*) as recordCount, COALESCE(SUM(taxAmount), 0) as totalTax FROM tax_record WHERE isDelete = 0 GROUP BY YEAR(calcTime), MONTH(calcTime) ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC LIMIT 12
